abyssinian: abyssinian has a slender, athletic body with short, close-lying fur and a warm reddish, tawny, or brown coat showing fine ticked banding. The head is wedge-shaped with large upright ears, almond-shaped eyes, a narrow muzzle, long legs, and a tapering tail with darker shading.
american bulldog: american bulldog has a broad, muscular body with a deep chest, short smooth coat, and predominantly white coloring often combined with brown, brindle, or tan patches. The head is large and blocky, with a wide muzzle, small folded ears, sturdy legs, and a thick tapering tail.
american pit bull terrier: american pit bull terrier has a compact, muscular body with a short glossy coat in varied solid, patched, or brindled colors. The head is broad with pronounced cheek muscles, a medium-length muzzle, small folded or semi-pricked ears, round eyes, strong legs, and a medium tapering tail.
basset hound: basset hound has a long, heavy body carried on very short legs, with smooth fur commonly patterned in white, tan, brown, and black. The head is large with a long muzzle, deeply drooping ears, loose facial skin, dark expressive eyes, heavy paws, and a long slightly curved tail.
beagle: beagle has a compact body with a short, dense tricolor coat, with black, white, and tan patches. The head is moderately broad, long floppy ears, large dark eyes and an upright or curved tail.
bengal: bengal has a sleek, muscular body with short dense fur and a golden, brown, silver, or cream background covered by dark spots, rosettes, or marbled markings. The head is relatively small with rounded ears, almond-shaped eyes, a strong muzzle, long legs, and a thick tapering tail.
birman: birman has a medium-to-large body with long silky fur, a pale cream torso, darker color-point markings on the face, ears, legs, and tail, and distinctive white paws. The head is broad and rounded, with medium ears, blue eyes, a short muzzle, and a fully plumed tail.
bombay: bombay has a medium, muscular body covered in short, glossy, uniformly black fur. The rounded head has a short broad muzzle, widely spaced rounded ears, and large copper or golden eyes that contrast strongly with the dark coat. The legs are sturdy, and the tail is straight and medium length.
boxer: boxer has a powerful, square-proportioned body with a short smooth coat commonly fawn or brindle, often with white chest, leg, or facial markings. The head is broad with a short blunt muzzle, dark mask, folded ears, round dark eyes, muscular legs, deep chest, and a short or natural tail.
british shorthair: british shorthair has a compact, heavy body with dense plush short fur, often blue-gray but also appearing in solid, tabby, or patterned coats. The head is large and round with full cheeks, small rounded ears, large circular eyes, a short broad muzzle, thick legs, and a stout tail.
chihuahua: chihuahua has a very small, fine-boned body with either short smooth fur or longer feathered fur in many colors and patterns. The head is rounded with a short pointed muzzle, very large upright ears, prominent round eyes, slender legs, small paws, and a thin tail often carried upward.
egyptian mau: egyptian mau has a slender, athletic body with short fine fur in silver, bronze, or smoky tones, covered by distinct dark spots and facial striping. The head is slightly rounded with large upright ears, greenish almond-shaped eyes, a medium muzzle, long legs, and a banded tapering tail.
english cocker spaniel: english cocker spaniel has a compact, balanced body with medium-length silky fur and feathering on the ears, chest, legs, and abdomen. Coat colors may be solid, parti-colored, or roan. The head has a rounded skull, long drooping ears, dark eyes, a moderate muzzle, and a feathered tail.
english setter: english setter has a tall, lean body with long silky fur, extensive feathering on the chest, legs, ears, and tail, and a white coat finely speckled or patched with darker colors. The head is elongated with a long muzzle, low drooping ears, oval eyes, and long slender legs.
german shorthaired: german shorthaired has a lean, athletic body with a short smooth coat, commonly liver, white, or combinations of solid patches and fine ticking. The head is elongated with a strong muzzle, broad drooping ears, dark almond-shaped eyes, long muscular legs, a deep chest, and a straight tapering tail.
great pyrenees: great pyrenees has a very large, heavy body covered in a thick, long double coat that is primarily white, sometimes with pale gray, tan, or cream markings. The head is broad with small folded ears, dark almond-shaped eyes, a strong muzzle, sturdy legs, and a large plumed tail.
havanese: havanese has a small, slightly elongated body covered in long, soft, wavy or lightly curly fur in white, cream, tan, brown, black, or mixed colors. The head is rounded with a moderate muzzle, drooping feathered ears, dark eyes, short legs, and a long plumed tail carried upward.
japanese chin: japanese chin has a small, compact body with long silky fur, usually white with sharply defined black, reddish, or brown patches. The face is short and broad with a very short muzzle, large round dark eyes, feathered drooping ears, slender legs, and a heavily plumed tail arched over the back.
keeshond: keeshond has a compact, sturdy body with a thick double coat combining gray, black, and cream, plus darker shading around the face and ears. The head is wedge-shaped with small upright ears, dark almond eyes, a pointed muzzle, heavily furred legs, and a dense curled tail over the back.
leonberger: leonberger has a very large, powerful body with a long dense coat in golden, reddish-brown, or tawny shades and a distinct dark facial mask. The head is broad with medium drooping ears, dark eyes, a long strong muzzle, heavy legs, a deep chest, and a long feathered tail.
maine coon: maine coon has a large, long-bodied frame with thick semi-long fur, a prominent ruff, and varied solid, tabby, or patterned coloring. The head has a broad muzzle, high cheekbones, large tufted ears, oval eyes, substantial paws, long legs, and a very long bushy tail.
miniature pinscher: miniature pinscher has a small, compact, fine-boned body with a short glossy coat, commonly black and tan, chocolate and tan, or solid reddish shades. The head is narrow and wedge-shaped with a pointed muzzle, upright ears, dark oval eyes, slim straight legs, and a short tapering tail.
newfoundland: newfoundland has a massive, broad body with a thick, water-resistant-looking double coat that is usually black, brown, gray, or black-and-white. The head is large with a broad muzzle, small drooping ears, deep-set dark eyes, very sturdy legs, large paws, and a long heavily furred tail.
persian: persian has a compact, stocky body covered in very long dense fur in many solid, shaded, or patterned colors. The head is broad and round with a very short flattened muzzle, small rounded ears, large circular eyes, short sturdy legs, a pronounced neck ruff, and a full bushy tail.
pomeranian: pomeranian has a very small, compact body with a dense fluffy double coat that forms a pronounced neck ruff and full hindquarters. Colors vary widely, including orange, cream, black, and sable. The head is fox-like with small upright ears, dark eyes, short legs, and a plumed curled tail.
pug: pug has a small, compact, square body with a short smooth coat, usually fawn, beige, or black. The head is large and round with a very short wrinkled muzzle, dark facial mask, small folded ears, prominent round eyes, sturdy short legs, and a tightly curled tail.
ragdoll: ragdoll has a large, long-bodied frame with semi-long soft fur, a pale torso, darker point coloring on the face, ears, legs, and tail, and sometimes white facial or paw markings. The head is broad and wedge-shaped with blue oval eyes, medium ears, and a long bushy tail.
russian blue: russian blue has a slender, fine-boned body with a short, dense, uniformly blue-gray coat showing a soft silvery sheen. The head is wedge-shaped with large upright ears, vivid green almond-shaped eyes, a straight medium muzzle, long narrow legs, small rounded paws, and a long tapering tail.
saint bernard: saint bernard has a very large, heavy body with a dense short or medium-length coat, typically white with reddish-brown or mahogany patches and dark facial markings. The head is massive with a broad muzzle, drooping ears, deep-set dark eyes, powerful legs, and a thick long tail.
samoyed: samoyed has a medium-to-large, well-proportioned body covered in a very thick white or cream double coat with abundant neck and leg feathering. The head is wedge-shaped with small upright ears, dark almond eyes, a black nose, sturdy legs, and a large plumed tail curled over the back.
scottish terrier: scottish terrier has a small, low-set body with short legs and a dense wiry coat, commonly black but also brindle or wheaten. The head is long and narrow with a pronounced beard, dark deep-set eyes, upright pointed ears, a long muzzle, and a short thick tail carried upward.
shiba inu: shiba inu has a compact, athletic body with a dense double coat in reddish, sesame, black-and-tan, or cream tones, often with lighter underside markings. The head is fox-like with triangular upright ears, dark almond eyes, a tapered muzzle, straight sturdy legs, and a thick curled tail.
siamese: siamese has a slender, elongated body with short fine fur, a pale torso, and sharply darker points on the face, ears, legs, and tail. The head is long and wedge-shaped with very large triangular ears, vivid blue almond-shaped eyes, a narrow muzzle, long legs, and a thin tail.
sphynx: sphynx has a medium, muscular body with nearly hairless skin showing visible wrinkles, folds, and varied pigmentation or patterned coloring. The head is wedge-shaped with extremely large upright ears, prominent cheekbones, lemon-shaped eyes, a short fine muzzle, long slender legs, and a thin whip-like tail.
staffordshire bull terrier: staffordshire bull terrier has a compact, muscular body with a broad chest and short smooth coat in solid, brindled, or white-patched colors. The head is wide and deep with pronounced cheek muscles, a short broad muzzle, small folded ears, round dark eyes, strong legs, and a medium tapering tail.
wheaten terrier: wheaten terrier has a medium, square-proportioned body covered in soft, wavy, medium-length fur with a pale wheat, cream, or light golden color. The head has a rectangular appearance with facial furnishings, dark eyes, folded ears, a moderate muzzle, sturdy legs, and a medium tail carried upward.
yorkshire terrier: yorkshire terrier has a very small, compact body with long, straight, silky fur, typically steel blue along the back and golden tan around the face, chest, and legs. The head is small with upright pointed ears, dark round eyes, a short muzzle, fine legs, and a silky tail.
